integration.name: Infobip
integration.summary: A full-stack CPaaS with standout coverage across the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Europe — the regions where the big two are often routed through aggregators.

credentials.label: API Key
credentials.note: A single key; no paired secret.

config.label: Base URL
config.note: Infobip gives every account its own API host, so this is required.

strengths: Strong direct coverage in the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Europe
Single-key credentials — the simplest connection to set up
Per-account API host, so traffic never shares an endpoint with other tenants
considerations: Your account-specific Base URL is mandatory. Copy it from the Infobip portal rather than guessing a regional hostname.
